title: Audit log entry v1
description: An entry in an implementation's audit log, version 1: version 0 and the events of remote access, Certificate Transparency monitoring, token binding, withdrawn credentials and relays. Entries are hash-chained via prev. See SPEC-v0.md sections 9 and 14.

seq.description: At most 2^53 − 1, the largest integer every JSON parser reads exactly (SPEC-v0 section 9.4).

binding.description: Only with agent.registered and agent.reconnected: whether the agent's tokens are bound to a key (SPEC-v0 section 11.7 item 6).

revoked.description: Revocation status at evaluation time; absent = false.

group.description: The same in every decision entry of one request for several resources, or of a request for a renamed resource (SPEC-v0 sections 4.4, 9.1 and 11.4): a UUID (RFC 9562), lower case. With it, a deny that is not enforced can be recorded as denied for the whole request.

resource.description: Resource as requested or resolved; unknown categories and identifiers that the evaluation found invalid are also logged unchanged, so identifiers here are limited only in length and number (SPEC-v0 section 9.1).

entity_id.description: As the agent sent it, any character that I-JSON permits (SPEC-v0 sections 3.1 and 9.1): untrusted text wherever it is shown.

category.description: As the PEP gave it to the evaluation, any character that I-JSON permits (SPEC-v0 sections 3.1 and 9.1): untrusted text wherever it is shown.

areas.description: Set of areas of the resource as the PEP gave it to the evaluation, also when invalid (SPEC-v0 sections 3.4 and 9.1), any character: untrusted text wherever it is shown; absent or empty: the resource has no area.

critical.description: true: the directory marked the resource as critical at evaluation time; absent = false.

action.description: As the agent sent it, any character that I-JSON permits (SPEC-v0 sections 3.1 and 9.1): untrusted text wherever it is shown.

parameters.description: Parameters of the action that were input to the evaluation (SPEC-v0 section 4.5): integers or strings.

mandate.description: id and digest are required except with mandate.rejected, where digest is present if the document was a JSON object with a canonical form and id if it named one, and received is required (SPEC-v0 section 9.1).

received.description: Only with mandate.rejected, required there: SHA-256 over the bytes of the document exactly as they arrived, for a signed mandate those of the compact JWS; not a digest of Section 3.2 (SPEC-v0 section 9.1).

previous_digest.description: Required with mandate.updated (the version replaced); with mandate.proposed the version held when the proposal was recorded, if any; mandate.discarded repeats the proposal's value; absent with every other event. Differs from digest (SPEC-v0 section 9.1).

cause.description: Only with mandate.discarded (rejected, superseded, revoked, expired: why a proposal did not take effect) and mandate.rejected (invalid, signature, untrusted_issuer, succession, unsupported: why a mandate from outside was not accepted), required there (SPEC-v0 section 9.1).

vocabulary.description: The vocabulary the evaluation used for the category of the resource (SPEC-v0 sections 5 and 9.1): id and version as in its file. Only with decision and evaluation, and not with reason unknown_resource or unknown_category. For a category of Section 5 the id is https://home-mandate.org/vocabulary/v0, for an extension category the id of the extension; the schema cannot see the vocabulary, a verifier checks it.

enforced.description: Only false: a deny by the rules of a mandate in audit mode that the PEP did not enforce (SPEC-v0 section 4.6). Absent: the decision was enforced.

confirm.description: Only true: the deny that was not enforced required a confirmation, because a matching rule decides ask (SPEC-v0 section 4.6). Only with enforced. Absent: no confirmation was required beyond what the decision says.

cause.description: Why a request ended without an answer before its timeout (SPEC-v0 section 11.1). Only with outcome cancelled, and required there.

via.description: Channel through which the answer arrived, an implementation-defined code such as push or ui. Only together with by.

denied_by.description: Who or what denied: audit is a request the PEP did not execute because it could not record it (SPEC-v0 section 9).

count.description: Number of consecutive requests of the agent that this entry stands for. Only with denied_by rate_limit (SPEC-v0 section 11.2).

exported.description: Range of entries an export contained (SPEC-v0 sections 9.1 and 13): from_seq <= to_seq < the entry's own seq. Only with log.exported.

checkpoint.description: Signed statement about the log up to and including the previous entry (SPEC-v0 section 9.5).

log_id.description: Identifier of the audit log, a UUID of version 4 or 7 with the variant of RFC 9562, in lower case; the same in every checkpoint of the log (SPEC-v0 section 9.5).

signature.description: Compact JWS with detached payload (RFC 7515 appendix F), algorithm EdDSA or ES256.

directory.description: Change to the resource directory that affects the evaluation (SPEC-v0 section 11.4).

category.description: With added and removed optionally, with category_changed required: the category of the resource (SPEC-v0 section 9.1).

previous_category.description: Only with category_changed; differs from category.

areas.description: With added and removed optionally, with areas_changed required: the set of areas of the resource, empty for none (SPEC-v0 sections 3.4 and 9.1).

previous_areas.description: Only with areas_changed; another set than areas.

template.description: Change to a mandate template, a stored mandate draft from which the implementation creates mandates (SPEC-v0 section 9.1). Never its content.

name.description: Name of the template; displayed text.

digest.description: stored: the new content; removed: the last content; hidden, shown: optionally the current content.

previous_digest.description: Only with stored, if the template had content before; differs from digest.

issuer.description: Change to the issuers a verifier trusts and to their keys (SPEC-v0 section 7.1). kid only with key_added and key_removed, required there.
The issuer as a mandate names it (SPEC-v0 section 3.5).

kid.description: The key ID of the key added or removed (SPEC-v0 section 7.1).

config.description: Change to a setting that affects every evaluation, the anchoring of the log or remote access (SPEC-v0 sections 9.5, 11.4 and 11.7): the household time zone, the clock check, the checkpoint key, the public origin, remote access on or off, whether tokens that are not bound are refused, the key agents are shown and a proxy the implementation trusts. previous_value, if present, differs from value. Without value, the setting was removed: only for the checkpoint key, the public origin, the key agents are shown and a trusted proxy, and only with previous_value.

approver.description: Change to the humans the implementation lets answer approval requests (SPEC-v0 section 11.1).

id.description: Identifier of the approver in the user management, as in approval.by; displayed text.

binding.description: Only with agent.bound: the key the agent's tokens are bound to from now on (SPEC-v0 section 11.7 item 6).

jkt.description: JWK SHA-256 thumbprint of the key (RFC 7638), base64url without padding.

credentials.description: Only with credentials.withdrawn: whose access and refresh tokens lost their validity, and why (SPEC-v0 sections 11.3 and 11.7 item 2).

scope.description: all: of every agent; agent: of the agent the entry names.

cause.description: emergency_stop: together with an emergency stop; public_origin: the public origin changed; user: a human withdrew them; refresh_reuse: a refresh token was used a second time, which ends every token of its grant (SPEC-v0 section 11.7 item 6).

certificate.description: Only with cert.unexpected and cert.acknowledged: a certificate for the host of the public origin (SPEC-v0 section 11.7 item 7). names and issuer are taken from the certificate, which anyone may have obtained: they are recorded unchanged and shown as untrusted text (SPEC-v0 section 9.1). cert.acknowledged names either one certificate by its digest or, by public_key alone, every certificate for that key.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the DER of the TBSCertificate without the poison and the SCT list, base64url without padding.

status.description: alarm: valid since monitoring began or later; not_yet_valid: its notBefore lies after the check; past_exposure: it expired before the check.

names.description: The names of the certificate that match the host, at most 16.

issuer.description: The issuer of the certificate as its distinguished name.

public_key.description: SHA-256 of the SubjectPublicKeyInfo, base64url without padding.

logged.description: The time of its first log entry.

ct.description: Only with ct.status: the state of Certificate Transparency monitoring (SPEC-v0 section 11.7 item 7). ok: at least two independent sources answered within 24 hours; limited: only one; unavailable: none.

relay.description: Only with the relay.* events: what a gateway paired with a relay records (Home-Mandate Relay Specification, RELAY-v0). Values the operator sent are recorded unchanged and shown as untrusted text (SPEC-v0 section 9.1).

home_id.description: The home ID the operator assigned (RELAY-v0 section 2).

name.description: relay.paired: the standard name; relay.protection_changed and relay.caa_alarm: the name concerned; for relay.caa_alarm at the apex, the apex of the name domain.

cause.description: Only with relay.unpaired. local: the gateway ended the pairing at its administrator's request; operator: the operator answered unpaired (the household's portal, a replacement by another gateway, the end of the service); offline_too_long: the operator answered offline-too-long or the gateway's own limit passed; bad_signature: the operator answered bad-signature, also after a key change that could not be recovered (RELAY-v0 sections 5.1, 5.5 and 5.7).

status.description: relay.status_changed: the status of the installation the operator reports (active, paused, blocked); relay.monitoring_status: whether the check works (ok, unavailable).

check.description: relay.monitoring_status: the query of the CAA records or the read of the installation (RELAY-v0 section 6.7); relay.pairing_refused: the check of the pairing response that failed, the standard name or the tunnel certificate (RELAY-v0 section 5.2).

reason.description: Only with relay.pins_ignored: why the gateway ignored a set of pins (RELAY-v0 sections 4.7 and 6.8). rules: the set breaks the rules of section 6.8, for example it changes the backup pins over a connection with an active pin; connection_pin: the pin of the connection is no longer stored in its kind; storage: the set cannot be stored durably; limit: the set is over the limit for connections with an active pin.

until.description: Only with relay.replacement_pending: the end of the waiting time the operator reports (RELAY-v0 sections 5.2 and 5.3).

source.description: Only with relay.pins_changed. relay: announced over a tunnel authenticated with a stored pin; admin: taken by the local administrator after a warning (RELAY-v0 section 6.8).

scope.description: Only with relay.caa_alarm: the standard name or the apex of the name domain (RELAY-v0 section 6.7).

account.description: Only with relay.acme_account_changed: the ACME account URI the gateway reported (RELAY-v0 section 5.6).

change.description: Only with relay.acme_account_changed (RELAY-v0 section 5.6). reported: the gateway reported the account and it took effect; pending: the operator asks the household to confirm it; confirmed: the household confirmed it and it is in force; not_confirmed: after the waiting time the account in force is still the earlier one; foreign: an account is in force that the gateway never reported.

prev.description: Digest of the previous entry; null only for the first entry of an audit log (seq 1).

sha256_b64url.description: A SHA-256 digest in base64url without padding.

domain.description: A DNS name of at least two labels in lower case, as A-labels, without a final dot.

public_origin.description: A public origin in its one form (SPEC-v0 section 11.7 item 1); a verifier also checks the rules of that item that a pattern cannot express.

proxy.description: An IP address or a prefix in CIDR notation, in its canonical text form: IPv4 in dotted decimal without leading zeros, IPv6 as RFC 5952 section 4 writes it, a prefix without host bits. The pattern is a first check; the canonical form is a rule of SPEC-v0 section 9.1 that a verifier checks.

setting_value.description: The value of a setting: an IANA time zone name, on or off for the clock check, a key ID for the checkpoint key; printable ASCII without space.

date_time.description: Timestamp according to RFC 3339 with offset; asserting format is required (SPEC-v0 section 3.1 item 0).

entity_id.description: Identifier of a resource in the directory: printable ASCII without space, compared exactly per character (SPEC-v0 section 3.4).

category.description: A category of SPEC-v0 section 5 or an extension category (section 5.1), as in a mandate.

areas.description: Set of areas of a resource in the directory (SPEC-v0 section 3.4); empty: no area.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical form according to RFC 8785, hexadecimal, lower case.

reason.description: Reason code of the evaluation, SPEC-v0 section 4.1.
